reason: A is the better proposal because it extends prior UHPS work with a testable quench-induced barrier concept and explicitly evaluates prolonged liquid-bath corrosion, whereas B largely repeats the cited UHPS study and merely assumes its oxidation benefits transfer to liquid-metal corrosion. A remains imperfect—the formation of a coherent ZrO2 layer during quenching is weakly justified, and an UHPS-without-quench control is needed to isolate the proposed mechanism.
